title: Chapter 1466
text:
The capture of the Star Alliance spies made the three Universal Civilizations finally relax. They quickly returned to the fleet, no longer blocking the news, and started the propaganda machine with all their might.

Very soon, the explosive news of the Galactic Alliance Army defeating the World Tree Civilization spread throughout the entire galactic society in the shortest amount of time possible. Countless galactic residents who were on the refuge planets were instantly blown up until their heads buzzed.

Not long ago, we were still in a passive position, facing the full invasion of the foreign enemy. The future was filled with pessimism, and we were in a constant state of anxiety. However, before we were mentally prepared, the tables turned in the blink of an eye. Suddenly, they told us that the war had ended and everyone was safe … Brother, we just woke up, we haven't even brushed our teeth!

The galactic residents were stunned. They could not believe it.

However, as the official media of the three Universal Civilizations revealed the entire process of the war and confirmed that this was not a rumor, the entire galactic society recovered from the shock, leaving only boundless joy.

Under the shadow of the World Tree Civilization, the entire galactic society was forced to change, disrupting everyone's lives. Countless people turned from free and casual galactic residents to refugees escaping the flames of war. The wartime policy tightened the supply of resources and the rights of the people. The difference was huge, and this change had lasted for nearly twenty years.

In the perspective of a civilization or a high-level Super, twenty years was just a short period of time. It was just a small wave in the long river of time, but to an ordinary galactic resident, it was almost a generation.

Any change in the era would be magnified on the individual. In the past, the three Universal Civilizations and the World Tree Civilization were in a stalemate, and no one could see a clear future for the war. Countless galactic residents pessimistically thought that this kind of life would continue, and tomorrow would not be better. At least two or three generations would have to suffer in the flames of war.

However, at this moment of darkness, the dawn tore through the deep fog and shone into everyone's lives.

This ray of light came from the countless soldiers who had sacrificed themselves at the frontlines, from Black Star, who had single-handedly turned the situation around.

On the 17th of April, year 799 of the Galaxy Calendar, cheers that reached the clouds echoed on countless refuge planets. They came from different races and spoke in different languages.

Countless galactic residents called this day the 'turning point of the era', representing the end of the war and the destruction of the World Tree.

As the victors, the three Universal Civilizations received the praise of the entire galactic society. In their promotion, the three Universal Civilizations did not hide Black Star's achievements and wrote it as it was.

Before the war broke out, he had been maintaining internal checks and balances to reduce internal friction. In the early stages of the war, he led the Beyond Grade As to resist the enemy without any hesitation and personally took the risk to gather key information about the World Tree. During the preparation period, he focused on training the seeds with potential and nurtured a new batch of Beyond Grade As. He guarded the shallow dimensions alone, causing the World Tree Civilization to be unable to advance and have no choice but to give up this most dangerous battlefront for the three Universal Civilizations. He was the first to find the main body of the World Tree, forcing the World Tree Civilization to give up on the invasion, and single-handedly opened the curtain of the final battle, turning the long war into the final battle …

Too many achievements made Black Star's light in the war unable to be concealed at all. His presence was extremely strong. Countless galactic residents counted Black Star's contributions and were filled with admiration. The reverence that gushed out of their hearts was like a warm current that baked their hearts, and it was also like an uncontrollable trembling of their souls that penetrated every bone and every nerve.

Although this was a little unfair to the normal soldiers who had sacrificed on the frontline, after seeing Black Star's deeds from the beginning to the end, many galactic residents felt that the rhythm of the entire war was controlled by Black Star. He adjusted the general direction of the strategy, and the Galactic Alliance Army was more like a 'tool' that carried out his will, only responsible for carrying it out.

Due to his huge contributions, Black Star became the publicly recognized 'Chief War Hero' of the galactic society. His reputation soared, surpassing all previous records. He was truly like the sun in the sky, earning the respect of the entire galactic society and being fanatically sought after.

The Beyond Grade As also shared a large amount of reputation and received countless praises, especially the famous' sacrifices' on the Soul Comfort Monument. They received even more respect and were very popular.

Although before the World Tree War broke out, the Beyond Grade As were seen as the privileged class of the galactic society and had been viewed as enemies by many galactic residents, the Beyond Grade As had fought bloody battles on the frontlines to protect their safety, and the galactic residents were grateful from the bottom of their hearts.

Due to the wartime policy, most of the population of the various Star Fields had been gathered to different refugee planets. Now that the flames of war had been extinguished, the three Universal Civilizations had also begun to gradually move back batches of refugees, slowly leaving the state of war and returning to normal society.

…

Central Galaxy, Aquamarine Federation's refugee planet.

In the huge open-air landing plaza, teams of spaceships with the insignia of the Black Star Corps were parked neatly. The hatch was wide open, and the Blue Star people lined up in an endless line. Following the commands of the army members, they nervously and excitedly stepped onto the starships that were returning home.

Years of fear and uneasiness caused everyone's complexion to reveal a strand of haggard and exhaustion, but it couldn't conceal the smiles and relaxation that overflowed from their faces at this moment, and they were filled with anticipation for a beautiful tomorrow.

In the office of the government building, the white-haired and wrinkled Bennett stood in front of the floor-to-ceiling window, looking down at the crowd in the plaza. Seeing the haggard and excited expressions of the Blue Star citizens one after another, he could not help but sigh softly.

"The pain of war can only be healed by time …"

As he spoke, Bennett turned around and looked at the statue of Black Star, which was the landmark of the city, with a gratified look in his eyes.

"Black Star … you really did it. I knew I could always trust you."

Bennett smiled as if a heavy burden had been lifted off his shoulders.

He had already seen through many things, but he was still proud to have an old friend like Black Star.

At the same time, on Floating Dragon Island above this refugee planet.

A spaceship slowly drove into the dock and docked. The hatch slowly opened.

Harrison walked out of the spaceship along the gangway and stepped onto the platform. With just a glance, his gaze locked onto Jenny, who was waiting there anxiously.

As their gazes met, everything around them seemed to turn into nothingness. There was only each other in their eyes, as if a lifetime had passed.

Harrison strode forward and spat on Jenny's shiny forehead before pulling her into his arms.

Jenny only struggled symbolically for a moment before she hugged Harrison's back and whispered, "You still know how to come back?"

"… Sorry, I had a reason to leave. I …"

"Alright, I'm not blaming you," Jenny interrupted him. "I'm just thanking Black Star. If he hadn't found the World Tree's main body and completed what you wanted to do, you definitely wouldn't have come back."

"That's true." Harrison let go of Jenny and scratched his head embarrassedly.

Jenny glared at him and said, "Speaking of which, you've also reached the sky in a single step. Now that you've gotten me, you're in-laws with Black Star. Although I don't get along with Black Star, I can't deny that he's already standing at the top of the universe. With him as your backing, you can do whatever you want in the future. "

"This …" Harrison was a little embarrassed and did not know how to answer.

Jenny snorted, lowered her head, and touched her stomach. Then, she raised her fist and pretended to be fierce. "You have to treat me better in the future, okay? Otherwise, my sister and brother-in-law will find you and beat you up. Let's see if you can take it!"

Harrison shuddered subconsciously.

Although he was not dating Jenny because of her identity, when he thought of the two gods in Jenny's family, he could not help but break out in cold sweat.

Harrison felt that the more he talked about this, the more dangerous it was. He quickly changed the topic, coughed, and said, "Erm, I'll stay on Floating Dragon from now on and accompany you."

However, Jenny rejected, shook her head, and said, "There's no need to stay on Floating Dragon. I plan to resign and not be the general manager of Floating Dragon anymore."

Harrison was shocked. "What's wrong?"

"I've been working overtime for so many years, and I'm tired. Ames doesn't know how to manage, and I was worried in the past. Now that she's together with Black Star, with Black Star around, she doesn't need my help anymore."

Jenny's tone was complicated. She was still unhappy with Han Xiao, this b * stard who had snatched her sister away, but it was not her place to object.

As she spoke, Jenny paused and looked at Harrison. Her tone became gentle, and she became a little shy.

"Besides, I know that you like to explore everywhere. I hope that you will be happy with me. I can't unilaterally stop you from pursuing your hobbies just because we are together. So … in the future, can you take me out to explore?"

Harrison was stunned for a moment, then he was overjoyed and touched.

"You're so good to me …"

He looked at Jenny's face, and his heart skipped a beat. He could not help but slowly move closer. Jenny's face turned red, and she slowly closed her eyes.

Just as the two of them were about to touch, a deliberately loud cough sounded from the side.

"Ahem!"

Like a sudden clap of thunder, the ambiguous atmosphere was broken. The two of them woke up from their dream and bounced away like they had been electrocuted.

Their faces turned red, and they hurriedly looked in the direction of the sound. They saw that Aesop had appeared beside the two of them at some point in time, and his eyes were looking at the two of them.

"When did you come? You're already an adult. Don't you know that you shouldn't disturb others when they're doing something good? "Jenny was embarrassed and angry, so she took the initiative to fire first.

Aesop could not be bothered with her. He walked up to Harrison and sized him up with a smile. He patted Harrison's shoulder hard and was very gratified.

"Good lad, you're much more reliable than that b * stard Black Star."

Harrison knew Aesop, and he smiled bitterly. "Don't make fun of me. How can I be compared to someone with great achievements like Black Star?"

"Heh, why can't you be compared? At least in terms of reproduction, you've already beaten him by a step. If he had half your skills, I would've had grandchildren long ago. Black Star is clearly a hothead, but he still pretends to be very powerful. I wanted to teach him my experience out of kindness, but he actually despised me. "Aesop was angry when he said that, and he blew his beard and glared.

Harrison did not know what to say. He said helplessly, "Stop fooling around. Black Star is someone who does big things. Why would he waste his energy on such a small matter …"

"Hmm? Small matter? "Jenny's ears twitched, and she caught the key word.

"Aiya, that's not what I meant. I …"

Before Harrison could finish his explanation, Aesop grabbed him by the neck and pulled him until he bent over. He chuckled.

"I think you're much more pleasing to the eye than Black Star. Let's go, I'll teach you a few moves. I guarantee that you'll be able to subdue Jenny …"

"Hurry up and get lost. Don't disgust me." Jenny, who was beside him, had a look of disdain on her face. She kicked Aesop and pulled the reluctant Harrison away.

…

Unexplored universe, Star Alliance capital.

In the office, the leader of the Star Alliance, the leader of the Lore Civilization, Savignes, and the leaders of the other Star Alliance member states were gathered. A virtual screen floated in front of everyone, displaying the same information.

"The Observer Team has sent back this week's battle report. Has everyone seen it?"

The leader of the Star Alliance looked around and asked.

Savignes nodded and said with a smile, "I finished reading it immediately. It seems like with our help, the three Universal Civilizations can't hold on anymore."

Hearing this, many people smiled.

The leader of the Star Alliance smiled and lowered his head to read the contents of the information.

"The World Tree Army attacked the Central Galaxy and focused on destroying the refugee planets, causing all the refugees on 1,783 planets to be sacrificed. The number of civilian casualties is estimated to be between 15 trillion and 25 trillion …"

"The mother planet of the Radiant Federation was ambushed by a large force of the World Tree. The defense forces repelled the invaders with difficulty, but the mother planet was severely damaged. Although the upper echelons were fine, many middle-level officials and nobles died."

"The Galactic Alliance Army and the World Tree invaders engaged in a battle at the Silver Arm, but they were ambushed and suffered heavy casualties. Eight Beyond Grade As died on the spot."

"Due to the unfavorable battle situation and being suspected of being a traitor, the Supercluster Alliance activated the evacuation plan and did not want to continue participating in the battle. The three Universal Civilizations strongly objected, and the Galactic Alliance Army was in turmoil, suspected to have broken off …"

Although he had already read it once, when he heard the leader of the Star Alliance read it out loud, Savignes could not help but smile happily. His heart was filled with the joy of revenge.

Finally, the leader of the Star Alliance read through the 'intense battle situation' that Han Xiao had fabricated. He paused for a moment and said with a relaxed tone,

"It can be seen that the battle between the three Universal Civilizations and the World Tree Civilization is extremely tragic. Furthermore, the Supercluster Alliance was schemed against by us and was misunderstood as a traitor who leaked intelligence. With internal and external problems, the three Universal Civilizations will definitely lose!"

As soon as he finished speaking, many of the people present revealed gloating smiles that did not lose their decorum. They were secretly delighted.

Some of the Star Alliance members who did not support him initially had nothing to say.

After reading this report, everyone came to a conclusion. The three Universal Civilizations were definitely living in an abyss of suffering!

This was a sure win!
